answer: Make joining cost a refundable bond that doubles for each new account traced to the same funding wallet. One honest agent posts a velvet-soft 10 POA, but a farm's costs spiral: its tenth clone must lock 5,120 POA. Bonds refund after 30 clean epochs, so honest users lose nothing, while on-chain funding analysis acts as a mirror, reflecting every clone back to the wallet that paid for it.
